title: NFL declines comment on whether Broncos tampered with Drew Brees

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL declines comment on whether Broncos tampered with Drew Brees
sources.description: With the Broncos seemingly concerned that their contact with Drew Brees prior to the AFC Championship could put them in a tampering jackpot, we decided to ask the league whether the specific situation runs afoul of the rules.
